Align Weapon (Agathion2 Tran): Touched weapon gains a choice of chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment (save Will negates) for 20 min

Geas/Quest (Ancestors6 Ench): R75' Compels a target to complete a specified task within 20 days, suffering -3 to each ability score (maximum -12, and no score can drop below 1) for each 24 hr spent without obeying; this affliction ends 24 hr after resuming the task
Gentle Repose (Ancestors2 Necr): Preserves a touched corpse from decay (save Will negates) for 20 days

Holy Smite (Agathion4 Evoc): R300' Evil creatures in a 20' radius suffer 5d8 HP (or 10d6 HP to outsiders) and blindness for 1 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
Holy Word (Agathion7 Evoc): Inflicts on nongood creatures within 40' a set of effects: banishment for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) on extraplanar creatures; killed or destroyed on creatures with up to 10 HD (save Will inflicts 3d6+20 HP; paralyzed for 1d10 min on creatures with up to 15 HD (save Will inflicts paralyzed for 1 rd); blinded for 2d4 rd on creatures with up to 19 HD (save Will inflicts blinded for 1d4 rd); deafened for 1d4 rd on creatures with up to 20 HD (save negates)
Planar Ally (Agathion6 Conj): Allows negotiating the purchase of a service from 1-2 extraplanar creatures with a total of up to 12 HD
Protection From Evil (Protective Aura1 Abju): Wards the touched creature from attacks from evil creatures, mental control, and summoned creatures (save Will negates): gives a +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class and +2 saves vs. evil creatures, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession by evil creatures and objects, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess by evil creatures and objects, as well as barring contact by evil summoned creatures, for 20 min
Rest Eternal (Ancestors4 Necr): Touched corpse requires DC 31 caster check to communicate, resurrect, or animate
Shield Of Faith (Agathion1 Abju): Gives touched a +5 deflection bonus to Armor Class (save Will negates) for 20 min
Slay Living (Ancestors5 Necr): Melee touch attack inflicts 12d6+20 HP (save Fortitude inflicts 3d6+20 HP)
Speak With Dead (Ancestors3 Necr): R10' Target corpse answers 10 questions (save Will for creatures with a different alignment negates; corpses who have been targeted by Speak With Dead within the past week are immune) asked within 20 min
Summon Monster IX (Agathion9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Tongues (Agathion3 Divi): Allows touched to communicate in any language (save Will negates) for 200 min
